changes.reason: LOCAL_REQUEST receipt identity now binds the complete immutable request (action/workspace namespace fingerprint, parentAttempt and checkpoint messages). The persisted operation requestHash and all approval/session/lease/permit identities are unchanged. Each finite Host prefix creates one initial operation; no rejection loop is in its action alphabet.

New pure request guard rejects a third identical diagnosable settled CLI failure. Execution and SessionScope do not request CLI operations; Host and ApprovalComposition create exactly one operation with no prior settled CLI failures, so the new guard is false throughout these domains. All claim/start/approval/recovery checks and atomic transactions are unchanged.
Adds synchronous metadata recommendation only; existing runtime binding probes do not call it. Command preparation, digest, approval and launch boundaries remain unchanged.
Adds metadata-only recommendation without changing startup discovery, snapshots or resource execution; the formal runtime binding fixture has no skill and never calls this new method.
Adds current-assignment guidance observations before model requests. The authority graph/runtime-binding drivers do not instantiate OpenAICompatibleAdapter or call model HTTP.

Adds metadata getter and treats CLI_REPEAT_FAILURE_LIMIT as feedback without creating an operation or executing. The authority graph/runtime-binding drivers call TeamEngine/LocalRuntime directly and do not instantiate WorkRunner.
